title: After the Tenno Sho (Autumn): Sprouting upon That Branch

text_block_list.name: Rose & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I—!
*I* will—!

text_block_list.name: Rose & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll win—!!
I'm going to winnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: First place, Rose Kingdom—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We surpassed them...!
That's one down for the Autumn Senior Triple
Crown!
(Woooooaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (However—Jordan.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(What an extraordinary thirst for
victory—!
My heart has not ceased its trembling even
now.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: She's tough, no two ways about it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaugh!!
Dammiiit—!! Rose!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not losing next time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right now I might just be an 'almost there'
Umamusume, but...!
...Ngh, that might be true, but still!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The one who's gonna hit it big is totally
meeee!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I have taken your feelings to heart.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are you laughing at?!
So annoying! You owe me a burger!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
you seriously don't have to treat me!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Forgive me, but
could you please prepare some cutlery?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, no way,
no way! —Isn't that way too cliché?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, earlier...
seriously, what were you laughing at?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I saw myself in you.
...And it brought me relief.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To think that rising again could be so
radiant—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A... comeback?
choice_data_list: The sight of you rising from hards...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's that even mean?!
Not really! That's totally normal!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like picking yourself back up when things
don't work out.
Everybody's doing it, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For me... sure,
there were definitely times
when things were rough, but...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wanna do my best,
and I wanna make my dream come true!
So like, duh, of course I'd do that much!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Those days of hesitation, straying,
and causing trouble... Through you,
Jordan...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(It seems to have melted, if just a little,
into my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn)..."
It was a race from which something truly
precious had been gained.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The path leading to the future is still
long.
There may be times we falter once more.
Yet—even so,
everything will surely be fine.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—The second leg of the Autumn Senior Triple
Crown.
Our next race is the Japan Cup.

The Japan Cup——
The battleground where, last year,
she surpassed
the queen of the era, Buena Vista,
and claimed victory.
choice_data_list: Once again this year, a fierce lin...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
And for that very reason,
let us make this a race that surpasses last
year's.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This autumn,
the passion of the public has been
ignited.
I shall etch the might of our Kingdom of
the Rose into their minds,
again and again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And eternal tranquility.
—Together with everyone.

Once more, toward the autumn international G1,
the Japan Cup—
I want to climb to the summit and claim
victory!
